intro.text: This entry describes common variable immunodeficiency-15 (CVID15), one of the genetically defined forms of common variable immunodeficiency. The causal gene and the reports that defined this form are not given here, because they could not be recalled with confidence.

checks.claim: Common variable immunodeficiency-15 (CVID15) is one of the genetically defined forms of common variable immunodeficiency.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract covers XBP-1 and plasma cell differentiation in mice. It does not mention CVID or CVID15.

paragraphs.text: Common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) is a primary immunodeficiency. It is marked by low serum levels of IgG together with low IgA and/or IgM, and poor specific antibody responses to vaccination. Patients have recurrent bacterial infections, mainly of the respiratory and gastrointestinal tracts. Some develop autoimmunity, lymphoproliferation or granulomatous disease.

checks.claim: Common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) is a primary immunodeficiency.
checks.evidence_quote: Currently known genetic causes for antibody deficiencies, some of which are diagnosed as CVID,
checks.explanation: The paper calls PADs primary immunodeficiencies and says some antibody deficiencies are diagnosed as CVID. It never says outright that CVID is a primary immunodeficiency.

checks.claim: Common variable immunodeficiency is marked by low serum levels of IgG.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not discuss IgG levels in CVID. It reports only that XBP-1-deficient mouse chimeras secreted little immunoglobulin.

checks.claim: In common variable immunodeficiency, low serum IgG occurs together with low IgA and/or low IgM.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not describe the CVID pattern of low IgA and/or IgM alongside low IgG.

checks.claim: Common variable immunodeficiency is marked by poor specific antibody responses to vaccination.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not mention vaccine responses.

checks.claim: Patients with common variable immunodeficiency have recurrent bacterial infections.
checks.evidence_quote: Even though CVID patients suffering only from infections have been reported to present a considerable subset in CVID cohorts (e.g. Resnick et al.: 32% of 473 subjects)
checks.explanation: This implies that CVID patients have infections, but the paper does not describe recurrent bacterial infections as a general feature of CVID.

checks.claim: The recurrent bacterial infections in common variable immunodeficiency mainly affect the respiratory and gastrointestinal tracts.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not mention which sites infections affect.

checks.claim: Some patients with common variable immunodeficiency develop autoimmunity.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not mention autoimmunity in CVID. Rheumatoid synovium appears only as a source of plasma cells.

checks.claim: Some patients with common variable immunodeficiency develop lymphoproliferation.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not mention lymphoproliferation in CVID.

checks.claim: Some patients with common variable immunodeficiency develop granulomatous disease.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not mention granulomatous disease.

paragraphs.text: CVID is genetically heterogeneous, and several numbered forms are each linked to a different gene. CVID15 is one of these forms.

checks.claim: Common variable immunodeficiency is genetically heterogeneous.
checks.evidence_quote: Currently known genetic causes for antibody deficiencies, some of which are diagnosed as CVID, impair early B-cell development, B cell receptor signaling or the functionality of B- or T-cells in the germinal center reaction.
checks.explanation: The paper implies multiple genetic causes of antibody deficiencies, some diagnosed as CVID. It does not state outright that CVID is genetically heterogeneous.

checks.claim: Common variable immunodeficiency has several numbered forms, each linked to a different gene.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not discuss numbered CVID forms or the genes linked to them.

checks.claim: CVID15 is one of the numbered, gene-linked forms of common variable immunodeficiency.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 3 cited papers. The abstract does not mention CVID15.
